name: manual_9fd72b
claim: git fetch origin upstream does not fetch the upstream remote: with two arguments the second is a refspec asked of origin, so it looks for a branch named upstream on origin. A script that then resets to upstream/main uses a stale or missing target. Fetch each remote explicitly (git fetch origin; git fetch upstream), and capture the target SHA after the fetch.

decisions.notes: Found 2026-10-14 in orama-system scripts/periscope/rebuild-deps-prs-onto-merged.sh while gating its re-point of main to upstream/main; the line read git fetch origin upstream --prune. Fixed in orama-system PR 404.
